name: ISS (NASA public OEM) Data Source
description: Executable data-source: pulls the NASA public ISS CCSDS OEM ephemeris over HTTP on a timer, re-emits it as a schema-exact SDS OEM record, and signs + publishes a PNM pointer.

timers.description: Periodic ISS OEM pull (default every 12h; NASA refreshes the continuous 15-day EME2000 ephemeris a few times a week — one small file, no per-object fan-out).

methods.description: Fetches the NASA public ISS CCSDS OEM ephemeris over HTTP, re-emits it as a schema-exact SDS OEM record, signs a PNM, and publishes it.

outputPorts.description: Signed PNM pointer published for each pulled + stored ISS ephemeris.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Signed PNM pointer for each published pull.

methods.displayName: Fetch + parse operator ephemeris and emit $OEM (OD-flow guest-link)
methods.description: Fetches the provider catalog via the host http connector (ps::http_get), parses to SDS $OEM in-memory, and emits one $OEM aligned-binary frame per object on the oem port. Nothing stored/signed/published.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Optional node CONFIG (endpoints/target/objectCap); default provider endpoints otherwise.
SDS $OEM ephemeris (aligned-binary), one per operator object. Consumed in-memory by analysis/od.fit; never stored.
